scheme_name: Marriage Assistance To Differently Abled Women (Parinayam-II)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Kerala.
The applicant can be the differently-abled girl herself or her parents.
The girl must have completed 18 years of age.
Combined annual family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000.
Financial assistance can be provided again for a second marriage if the first marriage dissolves.
If the disabled applicant dies before the daughter’s marriage, assistance can be given to the eldest responsible family member.
If the disabled applicant dies after the daughter’s marriage but before receiving assistance, a senior family member or the married member can receive assistance on a suitable bond.
Application must be submitted at least one month before the scheduled marriage date; for Muslim brides, the date after the Nikah ceremony is considered.
benefits_summary: A one‑time assistance of ₹30,000 is provided to eligible differently‑abled women for their marriage.
